head: claude/port-P0255-c075
title: Port P0255: 51 ready modules to Lean 4.36 (3 fixed, 48 unchanged)
body:
Refs #32617

Partial packet submission: **51 of 64 live members** of P0255 (the ready set from `port.py show P0255 --ready-only`). **The packet remains incomplete**; the claim #32617 stays open for the remaining members.

**Target:** Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0` (`Lean (version 4.36.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit 611c117bfaf7b7ae1cfcf246ce6fba31e8f509e9, Release)`), Mathlib `fc4f59e577feb1a4956671bc04ac18aaaf8cd842`.

### Fixed (3)
- **M073366** `InertiaEigenvalues.ProdTsumEqTsumIndicatorEnnreal`: `Finset.prod_le_prod` (semiring version with a nonnegativity hypothesis) is `Finset.prod_le_prod₀` in the target Mathlib. One-line rename, proof only.
- **M073400** `InertiaEigenvalues.QuadraticGaussIntegralStableOfDualLattice`: added a `show` restating the goal `{m | m ∈ M ∧ P m} ∈ 𝓝 0` as the definitionally equal `↑M ∩ {m | P m} ∈ 𝓝 0` so `Filter.inter_mem` unifies. Proof only.
- **M074311** `InertiaEigenvalues.SumLatticePairsIndexRpowLe`: the target compiler rejects code generation for the abbrevs `stdLat` and `lat` (they depend on noncomputable `Finsupp.instAddCommMonoid`), so both are marked `noncomputable`. This disables code generation only; the terms and types are unchanged. Equivalence note in the record.

### Unchanged (48)
M072892 M072908 M072912 M072942 M073010 M073012 M073032 M073150 M073154 M073156 M073158 M073170 M073287 M073305 M073370 M073387 M073411 M073698 M073838 M074056 M074057 M074216 M074218 M074226 M074228 M074230 M074300 M074512 M074705 M074721 M074741 M074781 M074903 M074958 M074961 M074962 M074965 M074967 M074978 M074981 M074990 M075012 M075084 M075087 M075179 M075362 M075408 M075420

No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `implemented_by`, `native_decide` or `unsafe` added. No statement changed. `check` printed no REUSED_NAMES warning for these modules.

### Remaining live members (13) and their unported imports
M073020 (M073019), M073199 (M073198), M073440 (M073439), M073627 (M073622), M073944 (M073943), M073954 (M073087), M074096 (M073087), M074333 (M005405), M074725 (M072653, M073087), M074760 (M074759), M075004 (M075003), M075062 (M073087, M075061), M075296 (M004836, M075295). No packet members are pruned.

python3 tracker/port_build.py prepare WORK   # toolchain linked from the official GitHub release zip, then lake update + lake exe cache get
python3 tracker/port_build.py check P0255 WORK --ready-only            # 48 of 51 built; 3 fixed above
python3 tracker/port_build.py diff P0255 WORK
python3 tracker/port_build.py reproduce P0255 WORK OUT --issue 32617 --ready-only   # == done: 51 of 51 modules built
lake env lean --run port/reused_audit.lean <51 modules>       # reused-audit: 51 module(s), 0 hit(s)
lake env lean --run port/islattice_audit.lean <51 modules>    # islattice-audit: 51 module(s), 0 hit(s)
python3 tracker/port_build.py records P0255 WORK --ready-only --notes notes.json --evidence <receipt URL>
